summary: Preserved and independently verified the candidate's narrow eager fallback for compact target verification on backends that do not support ragged verify graphs. No evidence justified enabling Triton compact graph capture or changing extend_attention_fwd.

tests.what_was_measured: Six mocked backend-capability and capture/replay admission boundaries passed on the exact candidate.

tests.command: temporarily remove only the candidate capture guard, then run /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-69d3f041e9d0/venv/bin/python test/registered/spec/dspark/test_ragged_verify_backend_capability.py
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before causality: unsupported compact capture entered warmup and triggered the test's AssertionError.
Passing-after regression with the guard restored; six tests passed.
Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015, AMD Instinct MI355X capability (9, 5), and TritonAttnBackend.supports_ragged_verify_graph=false.

gpu_execution.evidence: The GPU was queried for environment identification only. No Qwen hybrid model, extend_attention_fwd reproduction, or issue-specific GPU workload was executed.

remaining_limitations: Compact target verification for a Triton-backed Qwen hybrid remains on the eager path and does not use a CUDA graph.
The NVIDIA B300/CUDA 13.2 illegal memory access at batch size 20 and eight tokens per request was not reproduced or retested because the assigned device is AMD MI355X/gfx950 under ROCm 7.2.
The required Qwen hybrid and DSpark model weights were unavailable.
The regression validates mocked admission control only; it does not execute extend_attention_fwd or a full-attention/GatedDeltaNet hybrid model.
